comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT. Edits of an imported .f3d design recompute (mitcad#1904, GitHub #371), on the reported design (imported with mitcad-cli import-f3d, never committed; tools/cli/f3d-edit-reported-test.cmake). Its last component holds one body (F14.b0): a base, a tower on it (the extrusion F25 of 43 mm, d37), a support beside the tower (F27, 4 mm, d49), two tie-wrap cuts through it (F32 on the sketch's plane, F33 a 3 mm cut, d63, that starts on a construction plane higher up), chamfers, a fillet (F35, Fillet1) and a chamfer after it (F36, Chamfer3). Fillet1 builds, but its result deviates from the file's by a few cubic millimetres, so the import keeps it parametric only at the user's choice (--accept-deviations 37, as the test imports it, mitcad#1926); Chamfer3, the 0.5 chamfer of the pit's bottom loop after it, builds on that result too (OCCT port patch 1730) and comes in parametric, so that the final body follows the edits. Before the fix the record of F33 was read 10 bytes off (its start plane's selection was not recognised), so F33 came in as the file's bodies too and replaced the body after the tower: an edit of the tower changed nothing. Now F33 is a parametric cut, and the edits recompute every feature after them.
Fillet1 (F35) recomputes on the tower 7 mm higher: after it the tower's top is at -497 instead of -504 (mitcad#1926). The marker back at the end (36 features).
Chamfer3 (F36) recomputes on Fillet1's new result: the final body's tower top is at -497 too (mitcad#1926's Wanted item).

With the support beside the tower 6 mm high instead of 4 (d49), its legs' sloping tops start 2 mm above the plate behind a front face 2 high: on each side the foot's rounding of 2 and the top's rounding of 0.5 cross 0.71 mm behind that face, their ends at its two vertices. The geometry kernel reports them as overlapping (OCCT port patch 1780) and the fillet rounds the tops first and the feet on that result (mitcad#1987): Fillet1 builds, and Chamfer3 after it.
The final body: the tower's top still at -497, the body valid with Fillet1's and Chamfer3's faces (mitcad#1987).
Before Fillet1 the tower is 7 mm higher: its top at -497 instead of -504.

Fillet1's rounding of 3 (d96) along the fin's foot and of 0.5 (d98) along its top's edges, each added alone at the state before the fillet (mitcad#1926). The fin's arms are 2 thick, their outer sides lower than 3; the geometry kernel runs the rounding on over those sides' planes and cuts it by the fin's top, which grows out to meet it (OCCT port patch 1700). The roundings of 0.5 along the top's outer and inner edges, two chains running round the top, are built together by the kernel (OCCT port patch 1710). The whole of Fillet1, all its sets at once, builds too (OCCT port patches up to 1729): it is F35, imported parametric above.
